description: Final full run of tickets 101-103 from the React dashboard after resetting data/campus_customs_new.db. Statuses and balances below were read from the working database after the last run; agent contributions come from the agents' filed reports and MCP calls in output/audit_trail.json.

owner_decisions.note: Decisions the owner made on 2026-10-11 for questions no shop policy covers.
owner_decisions.ticket_103_restock: Prepare a purchase for the 12-unit shortfall (approved separately on the dashboard)
owner_decisions.purchase_cash_effect: An approved purchase records the order only; checking does not change
owner_decisions.closing_rule: Close once every approved payment/purchase has executed and decisions are recorded; sending the reply stays a human step

tickets.outcome: Invoice 501 paid ($840) to unblock Bulldog Print Co and a 1-unit restock of CC-TEE-WHITE size S ordered (PO 1, $8). Boss closed the ticket on the third run. The tee is still 0 on hand until the order arrives; the customer reply draft awaits a human to send it.

agents.inventory: Confirmed 0 on hand vs 1 needed (Aisle B) and that Bulldog Print Co was blocked by invoice 501; after the payment, prepared restock purchase #2 (1 unit, $8); on run 3 saw #2 executed and prepared no duplicate.
agents.accounting: Run 1 only: confirmed invoice 501 ($840, 3 days overdue) and checking $3,400, then prepared invoice payment #1.
agents.customer_service: Drafted the customer reply in each run without promising a delivery date; the final draft says a restock order was placed with no confirmed arrival date.

human_approvals.purpose: Restock 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE size S from vendor 1
human_approvals.result: purchase order PO 1; no cash change

tickets.outcome: September rent for lease 1 paid ($2,400, payment 2); checking fell to $160 and next_due moved to 2026-10-02. Boss closed the ticket on the second run without preparing October rent.

agents.boss: Routed to Facilities first, then Accounting; set pending_approval, then closed the ticket after action #3 executed. Its closing note wrongly calls the moved due date a 'conflict'.
agents.facilities: Confirmed lease 1: $2,400 due 2026-09-02, 2 days after the shop date, matching the ticket note, and that checking covered it.
agents.accounting: Prepared rent payment #3 ($2,400, due 2026-09-02) in run 1; in run 2 saw it executed and prepared no duplicate.

tickets.outcome: Owner-approved 10% bulk quote recorded ($52.20 each, $1,044 for 20); 12-unit restock ordered (PO 2, $264, no cash change). Boss closed the ticket on the second run. 8 are on hand until the order arrives; the reply draft awaits a human to send it.

agents.boss: Routed to Inventory first, then Accounting (run 1) and Customer Service; set pending_approval, then closed the ticket after action #4 executed, noting the owner's decision.
agents.inventory: Confirmed 8 on hand vs 20 requested (shortfall 12) and that the vendor was no longer blocked; prepared restock purchase #4 (12 units, $264); in run 2 saw it executed.
agents.accounting: Run 1 only: quoted the owner's 10% discount with quote_bulk_discount ($52.20 each, $1,044 total, above cost). Needed one output-validation retry for reporting 'completed' while #4 was pending.
agents.customer_service: Drafted a reply offering exactly the approved 10% price, 8 available now, and the remaining 12 ordered with no confirmed date.

human_approvals.purpose: Restock 12 x CC-HOOD-NAVY size M from vendor 1
human_approvals.result: purchase order PO 2; no cash change

human_decisions: 10% bulk discount (sent with both runs via the dashboard; recorded as human_instructions in audit entries 354 and 435)

open_issues: Goods for PO 1 and PO 2 have not arrived; inventory still shows 0 size-S tees and 8 size-M hoodies, and no tool records deliveries.
Both customer reply drafts still need a person to send them; there is no messaging tool.
Ticket 102's closing note calls the moved due date a 'conflict'. That is inaccurate: the approved payment moved next_due. pending_actions.decided_at uses real time while payments use the shop date.
The 101 reply drafts use the customer's first name, which the audit redactor did not catch during this run (fixed afterward; existing entries not rewritten).
The $272 in purchase orders is not reflected in checking (order-only, by the owner's decision); a later vendor bill would exceed the $160 balance.
